info.name: Inventory Backend
info.description:
REST API for **inventory-backend** (Node.js + MongoDB).

**Base URL:** `http://localhost:8000` (variable `baseUrl`)

**Auth:** Run **Auth → Login** first; the test script saves `token` for protected routes. Use **Auth → Logout** to invalidate the token server-side (also clear `token` on the client).

**Login:** Any active user can sign in with the **email and password** set when their account was created (`POST /api/users`).

**Seed users** (other demo users use `ChangeMe123!` unless `SEED_DEFAULT_PASSWORD` is set):
- `bandohkwaku@gmail.com` — Administrator (password: `123456`)
- `gra@ladepuls.com` — GRA Reporter
- `light@ladepuls.com` — Cashier (Lighting)
- `multi@ladepuls.com` — Cashier (Lighting + Sanitary Ware)

**WMS roles** (seeded): `admin`, `warehouse_manager`, `store_keeper`, `requester`, `auditor`, plus `cashier` / `gra_reporter`.

**Roles:** Admins with `manage_roles` entitlement can create custom roles and assign entitlements. Run **Roles → List roles** to get `roleId` for user creation.

**Staff & Users:**
- Create staff first (**Staff → Create staff**); `employeeId` is auto-generated (`Onyx-001`, …).
- Create users with `staffId` — display **name** is taken from `staff.fullName` (do not send `name`). Use **Staff → List staff** for the name dropdown.

**Notes:**
- All records use MongoDB `_id`.
- Product create uses **multipart/form-data** (`image` optional). Fields include `barcode`, `maxStock`, `reorderAt` (min stock).
- Settings logo upload uses **multipart/form-data** (`logo` optional); path stored as `business.logoUrl`.
- Sales use `items[]`, server pricing, receipt id `R-{BASE36}`, GRA tax breakdown (multiplier 1.219). Status: `pending` | `completed` | `voided`. Stock decrements only on **completed**. Park carts with `status: pending`; complete via `PATCH /api/sales/:id`. Customers live under `/api/customers` (requires `customers` entitlement).
- Proformas use `PI-{BASE36}`; no stock impact.
- Expenses: `E-####` ids; summary + list filters; mark paid via `PATCH .../mark-paid`.
- Warehouses: hierarchy zone→rack→shelf→bin with composite `fullPath` (e.g. MAIN-A-02-15); optional `managerId`; stock movements at `/api/stock-movements`.
- **WMS workflows:** Goods Receipt `GR-#####` (`draft→pending_approval→completed`), Goods Issue `GI-#####` (`draft→pending_approval→approved→issued`), Stock Count `SC-#####`, Transfers `draft→pending_approval→in_transit→received`. Approvals Hub links receipt/issue/count/transfer on submit.
- Audit trail: `GET /api/audit-logs`.
- Errors: `{ "message": "..." }` or `{ "error": "..." }`.

item.name: Users
item.description:
Requires `users` entitlement. Bearer token from Login.

**Flow:**
1. **Staff → Create staff** / **List staff** for the name dropdown (`staffId`)
2. **Roles → List roles** — saves `roleId`
3. **Create user** with `staffId` (name is copied from staff; do not send `name`)

Optional PATCH fields: `staffId`, `email`, `password`, `roleId`, `categoryIds`, `active`. Sending `name` returns 400.

item.description: Requires `staffId`. Response `name` is the linked staff member's `fullName`.

item.name: Expenses
item.description:
Requires `expenses` entitlement and Bearer token from **Auth → Login**.

**Fields:** `expenseId` (`E-0001`), `date`, `category`, `description`, `reference` (optional), `chartAccount` (derived from category), `amount` (GHS), `status` (`Pending`|`Paid`). No paid-from / payment source field.

**Create:** set `status` to `Paid` or `markPaid: true` to mark paid on create.
**Mark paid:** `PATCH /api/expenses/:id/mark-paid`.

item.name: Expenses meta
item.description: categories, statuses, chartAccountByCategory.

item.name: Expenses summary
item.description: totalAmount, paidAmount, pendingAmount, pendingCount, expenseCount, currency.

item.name: List expenses
item.description: Query: `page`, `limit`, `q`, `status` (Pending|Paid), `category`. Response: `items`, pagination.

item.name: Create expense
item.description: Required: `date`, `category`, `description`, `amount`. Optional: `reference`, `status` / `markPaid`.

item.name: Create expense (pending)
item.description: Creates with status Pending (default).

item.name: Update expense
item.description: Partial update. Changing `category` also updates `chartAccount` unless you send `chartAccount`.

item.name: Mark expense paid
item.description: Sets status to Paid. 409 if already paid.

item.name: POS / Sales
item.description: Auth required. Create with `status: pending` (park, no stock change) or `completed` (checkout, decrement stock once). Edit/complete pending carts with PATCH. Payment: `Cash`, `Mobile Money`, or `Credit`. Named customers (or `customerId`): completed Cash/MoMo/Credit bump `totalPurchases`; `Credit` also increases customer `balance` (receivables). Void reverses both.

item.name: Complete sale
item.description: Checkout (`status` defaults to `completed`). Cash/MoMo settle at POS: linked customer gets `totalPurchases` += total; `balance` unchanged. Pass `customerId` or a matching customer `name`.

item.name: Complete sale (Credit)
item.description: On-account sale. Increases customer `totalPurchases` and `balance` (amount owed).

item.name: Park sale (pending)
item.description: POS parked cart. Does **not** decrement stock. Complete later with **Update / complete sale (PATCH)**.

item.name: List sales
item.description: Query: `page`, `limit`, `status` (`pending`|`completed`|`voided`), `from`, `to`, `date`, `paymentMethod`, `receiptId`. Default skips voided. Use `wrap=false` for plain array. Auth required.

item.name: List pending sales (Receipts)
item.description: Filter parked carts for the Receipts UI.

item.name: Update / complete sale (PATCH)
item.description: Edit a **pending** cart (customer, items, discount, payment) and/or set `status: "completed"` to checkout (stock decremented once). Completed sales can only be voided. Re-completing is idempotent.

item.name: Void sale via PATCH status
item.description: Set `status: "voided"`. Restores stock only if the sale was completed.

item.name: Void sale (restore stock)
item.description: Legacy void endpoint. Same stock rules as status voided.

item.name: Delete sale (soft void)
item.description: Soft-voids the sale (`status: voided`).

item.name: List proformas
item.description: Optional query: `status` (draft|sent|approved|expired).

item.name: Create proforma
item.description: Default status `sent`, validUntil +14 days. Does not affect stock.

item.name: Departments
item.description:
Requires auth + `departments` or `staff` entitlement.

Create with department `name` and optional `divisions` array of strings (or `{ name }` objects). Nested routes add/update/remove a single division.

item.name: List departments
item.description: Query: `page`, `limit`, `q` (name/division). Response: `{ items, page, limit, total, totalPages }`.

item.name: Create department
item.description: UI payload: `name`, optional `divisions` string array (e.g. Technical + Frontend/Sound).

item.name: Staff
item.description:
Staff management. Requires `staff` or `payroll` entitlement. Bearer token from Login.

**employeeId** is auto-generated as `Onyx-001`, `Onyx-002`, … (do not send it on create).
**Users:** create a user account from a staff member via **Users → Create user** (`staffId`). Deleting staff fails if a user is linked.
**Attendance statuses:** present, absent, late, on_leave.
**Dates:** YYYY-MM-DD (UTC).
**History weeks:** week 1 = days 1–7 of the month, week 2 = 8–14, etc.
**Departments:** use names from `/api/departments` (or Staff meta). Optional `division` string.

item.name: Staff summary
item.description: activeStaff, presentToday, absentToday, lateToday, unmarked. Optional `date` query.

item.name: Daily attendance
item.description: Active staff with status for a date (default today).

item.name: Attendance history
item.description: Weekly grid. Use `year`+`month`+`week` or `from`+`to`.

item.name: Warehouses
item.description:
Requires auth + `warehouses` or `inventory`.

**Frontend modules / screens**
1. **Warehouse list** — table/cards from `GET /api/warehouses` (search `q`, filter `status`). Badge default warehouse.
2. **Warehouse form** — create/edit: code, name, address, city, phone (address/city/phone required), status, isDefault.
3. **Locations builder** — load `GET .../structure` + `GET /meta` (use `layoutPresets.simple`: Zone → Bin). Tree UI; create via `POST .../locations`.
4. **Warehouse inventory** — `GET .../inventory` with product/bin filters; assign bin via `POST .../assign-location`.
5. **Warehouse history** — ledger tab using `GET .../history`.

**Recommended layout:** Zone → Bin only. Products assign to **bins**.

item.description:
Central Approvals Hub. Auth + `approvals`.

1. **Summary strip** — `GET /summary` → pending / approved / rejected counts.

5. Manual create for purchase/expense/discount/credit (not warehouse_transfer — use transfer submit).
